mapper.select: SELECT t.tag_id as tagId, t.name as name, t.created_at as createdAt FROM post_tags pt JOIN tags t ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id WHERE pt.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY t.name

SELECT t.tag_id, t.name, COUNT(p.post_id) AS post_count FROM tags t LEFT JOIN post_tags pt ON t.tag_id = pt.tag_id LEFT JOIN posts p ON pt.post_id = p.post_id AND p.is_deleted = 'N' AND p.is_temp = 'N' AND p.is_public = 'Y' GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.name ORDER BY COUNT(p.post_id) DESC, t.name ASC
